description: Shows your remaining Fish Audio credits in the status bar.
command.setApiKey.title: Set API Key
command.clearApiKey.title: Remove API Key
command.refresh.title: Refresh Credit Balance
command.openBilling.title: Open Billing Page
config.title: Credit Balance for Fish Audio
config.refreshIntervalMinutes: How often the balance is refreshed, in minutes. The balance is also refreshed when you come back to a VS Code window and it is older than this.
config.warningThresholdPercent: Highlight the status bar item when the remaining plan credits fall below this percentage of the plan total. Set to `0` to turn the highlight off.
